intro: Ahanu is a tauren merchant operating within Hewa's Armory on the lower rise of Thunder Bluff. He crafts and trades leather armor to travelers and young braves setting out across Mulgore and the wider plains. He also helps newly arrived couriers navigate the bluffs when delivering messages from nearby settlements.

p: Situated amidst the leatherworking stalls and armories of Thunder Bluff's lower rise, Ahanu provides vital equipment to those who make their living across Kalimdor's grasslands. Working hides sent by his friend Jahan Hawkwing at the Crossroads, he represents the everyday tradesfolk who keep the tauren capital supplied with durable cured and tanned hide gear. For travelers fresh off a wind rider from the Crossroads, Ahanu frequently serves as a first point of contact in the grand city, receiving deliveries and directing messengers toward the local flight roosts.
